svg.title: Agentroid: the most phone control for the fewest tokens
svg.desc: Agentroid, an MCP server that lets an AI agent see and drive an Android phone. One real screen, a Xiaomi POCO X6 Pro home screen recorded on 20 Oct 2026, shown four ways in turn: the raw uiautomator dump, 30,910 characters; Agentroid's full ui_tree listing, 2,550 characters; the digest the agent gets by default, 453 characters; and a since= diff when nothing changed, 65 characters. 27 tools in under 5,000 tokens, and no model calls of its own.
